verses.original: כִּ֛י יִשְׂרָאֵ֖ל נַ֥עַר וָאֹהֲבֵ֑הוּ וּמִמִּצְרַ֖יִם קָרָ֥אתִי לִבְנִֽי׃
verses.transliteration: kî yiś·rā·’êl na·‘ar wā·’ō·hă·ḇê·hū ū·mim·miṣ·ra·yim qā·rā·ṯî liḇ·nî
verses.literal: When Israel was a child I loved him and out of Egypt I called My son

verses.original: קָרְא֖וּ לָהֶ֑ם כֵּ֚ן הָלְכ֣וּ מִפְּנֵיהֶ֔ם יְזַבֵּ֔חוּ לַבְּעָלִ֣ים יְקַטֵּרֽוּן׃ וְלַפְּסִלִ֖ים
verses.transliteration: qā·rə·’ū lā·hem kên hā·lə·ḵū mip·pə·nê·hem yə·zab·bê·ḥū lab·bə·‘ā·lîm yə·qaṭ·ṭê·rūn wə·lap·pə·si·lîm
verses.literal: But the more I called [Israel] the farther they departed from Me They sacrificed to the Baals and burned incense to carved images

verses.original: וְאָנֹכִ֤י לְאֶפְרַ֔יִם תִרְגַּ֙לְתִּי֙ קָחָ֖ם עַל־ זְרֽוֹעֹתָ֑יו וְלֹ֥א יָדְע֖וּ כִּ֥י רְפָאתִֽים׃
verses.transliteration: wə·’ā·nō·ḵî lə·’ep̄·ra·yim ṯir·gal·tî qā·ḥām ‘al- zə·rō·w·‘ō·ṯāw wə·lō yā·ḏə·‘ū kî rə·p̄ā·ṯîm
verses.literal: It was I who taught Ephraim to walk taking them by the arms but they never realized that it was I who healed them

verses.original: אֶמְשְׁכֵם֙ בְּחַבְלֵ֨י אָדָ֤ם בַּעֲבֹת֣וֹת אַהֲבָ֔ה וָאֶהְיֶ֥ה לָהֶ֛ם כִּמְרִ֥ימֵי עֹ֖ל עַ֣ל לְחֵיהֶ֑ם וְאַ֥ט אֵלָ֖יו אוֹכִֽיל׃
verses.transliteration: ’em·šə·ḵêm bə·ḥaḇ·lê ’ā·ḏām ba·‘ă·ḇō·ṯō·wṯ ’a·hă·ḇāh wā·’eh·yeh lā·hem kim·rî·mê ‘ōl ‘al lə·ḥê·hem wə·’aṭ ’ê·lāw ’ō·w·ḵîl
verses.literal: I led them with cords of kindness with ropes of love vvv vvv I lifted the yoke from their necks and bent down . . . to feed them

verses.original: לֹ֤א יָשׁוּב֙ אֶל־ אֶ֣רֶץ מִצְרַ֔יִם מַלְכּ֑וֹ וְאַשּׁ֖וּר ה֣וּא כִּ֥י מֵאֲנ֖וּ לָשֽׁוּב׃
verses.transliteration: lō yā·šūḇ ’el- ’e·reṣ miṣ·ra·yim mal·kōw wə·’aš·šūr hū kî mê·’ă·nū lā·šūḇ
verses.literal: Will they not return to the land of Egypt and be ruled by Assyria . . . because they refused to repent

verses.original: חֶ֙רֶב֙ וְחָלָ֥ה בְּעָרָ֔יו וְכִלְּתָ֥ה בַדָּ֖יו וְאָכָ֑לָה מִֽמֹּעֲצ֖וֹתֵיהֶֽם׃
verses.transliteration: ḥe·reḇ wə·ḥā·lāh bə·‘ā·rāw wə·ḵil·lə·ṯāh ḇad·dāw wə·’ā·ḵā·lāh mim·mō·‘ă·ṣō·w·ṯê·hem
verses.literal: A sword will flash through their cities it will destroy the bars of their gates and consume [them] in their own plans

verses.original: וְעַמִּ֥י תְלוּאִ֖ים לִמְשֽׁוּבָתִ֑י יִקְרָאֻ֔הוּ וְאֶל־ עַל֙ לֹ֥א יַ֖חַד יְרוֹמֵם׃
verses.transliteration: wə·‘am·mî ṯə·lū·’îm lim·šū·ḇā·ṯî yiq·rā·’u·hū wə·’el- ‘al lō ya·ḥaḏ yə·rō·mēm
verses.literal: My people are bent on turning from Me Though they call to the Most High He will by no means . . . exalt them

verses.original: אֵ֞יךְ אֶתֶּנְךָ֣ אֶפְרַ֗יִם אֲמַגֶּנְךָ֙ יִשְׂרָאֵ֔ל אֵ֚יךְ אֶתֶּנְךָ֣ כְאַדְמָ֔ה אֲשִֽׂימְךָ֖ כִּצְבֹאיִ֑ם לִבִּ֔י נֶהְפַּ֤ךְ עָלַי֙ יַ֖חַד נִחוּמָֽי׃ נִכְמְר֥וּ
verses.transliteration: ’êḵ ’et·ten·ḵā ’ep̄·ra·yim ’ă·mag·gen·ḵā yiś·rā·’êl ’êḵ ’et·ten·ḵā ḵə·’aḏ·māh ’ă·śî·mə·ḵā kiṣ·ḇō·yim lib·bî neh·paḵ ‘ā·lay ya·ḥaḏ ni·ḥū·māy niḵ·mə·rū
verses.literal: How could I give you up O Ephraim How could I surrender you O Israel How could I make you like Admah How could I treat you like Zeboiim My heart is turned within Me My compassion is stirred

verses.original: לֹ֤א אֶֽעֱשֶׂה֙ חֲר֣וֹן אַפִּ֔י לֹ֥א לְשַׁחֵ֣ת אֶפְרָ֑יִם אָשׁ֖וּב כִּ֣י אָֽנֹכִי֙ אֵ֤ל וְלֹא־ אִ֔ישׁ קָד֔וֹשׁ בְּקִרְבְּךָ֣ וְלֹ֥א אָב֖וֹא בְּעִֽיר׃
verses.transliteration: lō ’e·‘ĕ·śeh ḥă·rō·wn ’ap·pî lō lə·ša·ḥêṯ ’ep̄·rā·yim ’ā·šūḇ kî ’ā·nō·ḵî ’êl wə·lō- ’îš qā·ḏō·wōš bə·qir·bə·ḵā wə·lō ’ā·ḇō·w bə·‘îr
verses.literal: I will not execute the full fury of My anger I will not destroy Ephraim again For I am God and not man the Holy One among you and I will not come in wrath

verses.original: אַחֲרֵ֧י יֵלְכ֖וּ יְהוָ֛ה יִשְׁאָ֑ג כְּאַרְיֵ֣ה כִּֽי־ ה֣וּא יִשְׁאַ֔ג בָנִ֖ים וְיֶחֶרְד֥וּ מִיָּֽם׃
verses.transliteration: ’a·ḥă·rê yê·lə·ḵū Yah·weh yiš·’āḡ kə·’ar·yêh kî- hū yiš·’aḡ ḇā·nîm wə·ye·ḥer·ḏū mî·yām
verses.literal: They will walk after . . . the LORD He will roar like a lion When He roars His children will come trembling from the west

verses.original: יֶחֶרְד֤וּ כְצִפּוֹר֙ מִמִּצְרַ֔יִם וּכְיוֹנָ֖ה מֵאֶ֣רֶץ אַשּׁ֑וּר וְהוֹשַׁבְתִּ֥ים עַל־ בָּתֵּיהֶ֖ם נְאֻם־ יְהוָֽה׃ס
verses.transliteration: ye·ḥer·ḏū ḵə·ṣip·pō·wr mim·miṣ·ra·yim ū·ḵə·yō·w·nāh mê·’e·reṣ ’aš·šūr wə·hō·wō·šaḇ·tîm ‘al- bāt·tê·hem nə·’um- Yah·weh
verses.literal: They will come trembling like birds from Egypt and like doves from the land of Assyria Then I will settle them in their homes declares the LORD

verses.original: אֶפְרַ֔יִם סְבָבֻ֤נִי בְכַ֙חַשׁ֙ בֵּ֣ית יִשְׂרָאֵ֑ל וּבְמִרְמָ֖ה וִֽיהוּדָ֗ה עֹ֥ד רָד֙ עִם־ אֵ֔ל נֶאֱמָֽן׃ וְעִם־ קְדוֹשִׁ֖ים
verses.transliteration: ’ep̄·ra·yim sə·ḇā·ḇu·nî ḇə·ḵa·ḥaš bêṯ yiś·rā·’êl ū·ḇə·mir·māh wî·hū·ḏāh ‘ōḏ rāḏ ‘im- ’êl ne·’ĕ·mān wə·‘im- qə·ḏō·wō·šîm
verses.literal: Ephraim surrounds Me with lies the house of Israel with deceit but Judah still walks with God [and is] faithful to the Holy One
